title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT ME VERANDE TEK GARDA E REPUBLIKES
description_sq:
SHITET APARTAMENT ME VERANDE TEK GARDA E REPUBLIKES
Apartamenti ndodhet ne rrugen Lidhja e Prizrenit prane "Xheko Imperial".
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3-te nje pallati cilesor dhe te mireadministruar.
Organizohet nga:
- Korridori i shpërndares.
-Dhoma e ndenjes e cila ka nje hapesire te bollshme me akses ne verande, ambjent kuzhine dhe ngrenie dhe nje tualet.
-Tre dhoma gjumi secila me tualet te brendshem dhe nje dhome matrimoniale me dollap me vete dhe dalje ne verande.
Orientimi Veri-Lindje.
Prona eshte investuar ne parket druri te cilesise se larte, sistem qendror chiller per ngrohje/ftohje, grila dhe dritare druri me dopio xham, duke mundesuar izolim termik dhe akustik, punime elektrike dhe hidraulike cilesore, arredim te stilit klasik, tualete me hidrosanitare me emrat e markave me te mira, perfshi xhakuzi etj.
Prona ka dokumentacion te rregullt.
Për informacion të detajuar ose një vizitë në pronë, mund të na kontaktoni.
title_en: APARTMENT WITH VERANDA FOR SALE NEAR THE GUARD OF THE REPUBLIC
description_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE WITH VERANDA NEAR THE REPUBLIC GUARD The apartment is located on Lihda e Prizren Street near "Xheko Imperial". The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a quality and well-managed building. It is organized by: - ​​Distribution corridor. - Living room which has a spacious space with access to the veranda, kitchen and dining area and a toilet. -Three bedrooms each with an internal toilet and a matrimonial room with its own closet and exit to the veranda. Orientation North-East. The property has been invested in high-quality wooden parquet, central chiller system for heating/cooling, shutters and wooden windows with double glazing, enabling thermal and acoustic insulation, quality electrical and plumbing works, classic style furnishings, hydro-sanitary toilets with the best brand names, including Jacuzzi, etc. The property has proper documentation. For detailed information or a visit to the property, you can contact us.
